text: Gir cattle require 40-50 liters of clean water daily. Provide balanced nutrition with green fodder, dry fodder, and concentrates. Monitor body condition regularly.
source: ICAR Livestock Care Guidelines - Gir Breed

text: Sahiwal cattle are known for heat tolerance. Ensure adequate shade and water during summer months. Provide high-quality green fodder for optimal milk production.
source: ICAR Livestock Care Guidelines - Sahiwal Breed

text: Monitor body condition score regularly. Thin animals (BCS < 3) may need nutritional support. Consult veterinarian for dietary adjustments.
In summer months, provide shade and ensure adequate water supply. Watch for heat stress symptoms: excessive panting, reduced feed intake, lethargy.
Dull coat may indicate nutritional deficiencies or health issues. Ensure balanced diet with adequate minerals and vitamins. Consult veterinarian if condition persists.
Murrah buffalo require 50-60 liters of water daily. Provide wallowing facilities if possible. High-quality green fodder essential for milk production.
source: ICAR Livestock Care Guidelines - Murrah Breed

text: Regular health monitoring includes checking for eye/nose discharge, body condition, coat quality, and general behavior. Early detection helps prevent serious issues.
Ongole cattle are well-adapted to hot climates. Provide adequate shade and water. They thrive on good quality green and dry fodder.
source: ICAR Livestock Care Guidelines - Ongole Breed
